Homebrew git 2.40.0 (2023) sends the pack as HTTP/2 chunked and GitHub-Babel 400s the POST with an empty body; fix is brew upgrade git, not http.version pinning. Check git --version and PATH order (brew shadows Apple git) when pushes fail but dry-runs succeed.

.beads/issues.jsonl is the designed git-committed ledger copy (ledger-push.sh regenerates it with memories on every push; fresh clones hydrate from it) — commit it, never ignore or delete it. Untracked copy is a bug, tracked upstream in harness-starter har-l5a.
